meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 接手 `migrate-v2.sh` 跑完后剩下的迁移工作:先读 handoff.json 看各步骤结果,排查失败项,再授予 owner 角色、迁移 v1 旧记忆、核对容器配置,并帮你搬运 v1 的自定义代码。
howto.when: 当你提到 “migrate from v1”、“finish migration”、“v1 migration” 等说法时触发;前提是 `bash migrate-v2.sh` 已经在终端里跑完,handoff.json 存在。

say.text: 帮我完成 v1 到 v2 的迁移
say.note: 它会先读 handoff.json 看哪些步骤失败

say.text: 把 v1 的旧记忆迁移过来
帮我看看 v1 有哪些自定义代码可搬
say.note: 对比上游提交后给你三个选项

howto.what_en: Takes over after `migrate-v2.sh`: reads handoff.json, triages failed steps, grants the owner role, runs the shared-memory migration, reconciles container.json, and helps port v1 fork customizations.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "migrate from v1", "finish migration", or "v1 migration", and only once `bash migrate-v2.sh` has finished and handoff.json exists.

say_en.text: Finish the v1 to v2 migration for me
Migrate the old v1 memory over
Show me which v1 customizations to carry over
